cursor.frontmatter:
name: bugfix-probe
description: >-
  Locates a bug by reading the relevant code, adding debug logs, and stopping
  with platform filter lines until the user returns logs. Android logcat OR is
  `|` with no spaces; iOS and Web get one search string per line unless the
  user says iOS regex is on. Use when the user wants diagnostic logs and
  filters, pastes logs from a previous round, or names bugfix-probe. Does not
  claim a root cause from code reading alone. Pair with bugfix-logclean after
  the fix is confirmed.
disable-model-invocation: true
